The site is Pine Crossing. I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message.

Pree said it herself in #central-team on Jun 9: the Pine Crossing morning receiver reported that the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver arrived at 7:10 and they wrote his trailer number on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and have support reproduce it using the store login. The channel shows no follow-up after that, so I told her I don't know whether it's been fixed.
